state.description: Where the document is. numbered, signed and submitted: issued, with its fiscal number and security code, and not yet registered by the authority. accepted: registered; registrationCode is set. deferred: the authority could not be reached, and the document is sent again with its reason code. rejected: the authority refused it; it is corrected, never resent. repudiated: refused by the authority's later check after it was accepted. settled: accepted and through that later check. superseded: a corrective replaced it. draft: stored, not yet numbered. accepted is not settled.

get.description: Documents the worker parked because a resend must declare a reason code and the recorded answer supports none (DEV-1806). Nothing sends them until a person declares the cause (POST /v1/documents/{id}/reason-code). Most urgent first. Each row gives, for every cause that could be declared, the statutory deadline and the time left on it, the authority's acceptance limit, the calendar source, and whether the clock's start is still unconfirmed (legal-decisions O2).
The drafts the templates' schedules prepared and that wait for a person to issue them.

post.description: Says which invoice a person issued from the draft. Issues nothing itself.
An Owner or Accountant approves the exact invoice the template's schedule then issues on its own.

get.description: DEV-2356: the cash a device's register should hold today (Tirana), as eFis estimates it: the day's opening float, plus deposits, minus withdrawals, plus the device's notes-and-coins payments in lekë (a credit note's negative payments subtract). A deposit the authority refused is left out. Cash in another currency is counted apart and not added. The authority keeps no such figure: estimate is always true.

post.description: Registers a cash operation (INITIAL, DEPOSIT or WITHDRAW) from the console form. Signed in (X-Session) as the business's own Owner or Accountant, with the password typed again (and a current code when two-factor is on). The console channel submits it through the same handler as POST /v1/cash-deposits, and its answer is returned unchanged. Idempotency-Key is passed through. 503 console_form_unavailable when the deployment has not set the channel's key.

get.description: The registered document as the console's corrective form starts from it: the request that issued it, rebuilt and checked to give back the same document. 422 console_correction_unsupported when the document carries something the console's forms do not (a fee, a supply period, a discount, a reference); the software that issued it corrects it then. 422 console_correction_cash for a cash document: the console channel has no device to issue its reversal. Signed in as the business's own Owner or Accountant.

post.description: Corrects a registered document from the console: the invoice as it should have been. With preview, says what the correction takes (difference: one corrective; reversal_and_replacement: two documents) and numbers nothing. Without it, the password is typed again (and a current code when two-factor is on), and the console channel submits the plan through the same path as POST /v1/documents/{id}/corrections, whose answer is returned unchanged. Idempotency-Key is required to issue and passed through. The documents carry efis's own recorded software code.

Issues an invoice from the console invoice form. Signed in (X-Session) as the business's own Owner or Accountant, with the password typed again (and a current code when two-factor is on). The person's session does not submit: the console channel, a client system with its own credential, submits the document through the same path as POST /v1/documents, and its answer is returned unchanged. Idempotency-Key is passed through. On an electronic invoice the form requires paymentDueDate and einvoice.payment.accountId (the IBAN); the public submit route keeps both optional. The invoice carries efis's own recorded software code (409 platform_software_code_missing until the platform has recorded one). 503 console_form_unavailable when the deployment has not set the channel's key (Efis:Console:ChannelKey).

DEV-2361: the console form's invoice, checked as it is typed. The form's request is completed as an issue would complete it (the prices before VAT, the payment's amount, efis's software code) and run through every check POST /v1/documents runs before numbering, through the console channel. No password: nothing is numbered, signed or stored. Signed in as the business's own Owner or Accountant.

Issues a warehouse transfer note from the console form. Signed in (X-Session) as the business's own Owner or Accountant, with the password typed again (and a current code when two-factor is on). The console channel submits the note through the same handler as POST /v1/transport-documents, and its answer is returned unchanged. The note carries efis's own recorded software code. Idempotency-Key is passed through. 503 console_form_unavailable when the deployment has not set the channel's key.

DEV-2425: issues a transport invoice (registerTI) from the console form. Signed in (X-Session) as the business's own Owner or Accountant, with the password typed again (and a current code when two-factor is on). The console channel submits it through the same handler as POST /v1/transport-invoices, and its answer is returned unchanged, 503 transport_invoices_disabled included. It carries efis's own recorded software code. Idempotency-Key is passed through.

Rate limited per taxpayer: a budget of submissions per minute (Efis:RateLimits:DocumentWritesPerMinute, 600 unless the deployment says otherwise), per caller of a taxpayer; a batch costs one per document and is refused whole when it does not fit. Every answer carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; a refusal is 429 rate_limited with Retry-After, and spends no number.

get.description: Without filters, every document of the taxpayer (DocumentListResponse). With any of state (comma-separated), issuedFrom, issuedTo (timestamps with an offset; half-open), businessUnit, limit (1-500, default 100) or after (the previous page's next), one page in the order documents were written, the same shape plus next, the cursor for the following page: the poller's read, which returns every document exactly once. Without the paging filters, mustAct=true keeps only the documents the taxpayer must act on (tenantMustAct; DEV-2423). Each item carries issuedAt, the buyer (identifier and name, or null) and the total with two decimals and its currency, as issued.

post.description: Issues the document. 202 means it is issued (state numbered, with its fiscal number and security code) and not yet registered by the authority: registrationCode is null. Registration follows without another call. The result arrives as a webhook (document.fiscalised, document.deferred or document.rejected), and GET /v1/documents/{id} shows it in state at any time; GET /v1/documents/{id}/steps shows a step that waits for a person. A send the authority could not receive is retried by efis, and one it refused is never resent; there is no resend call. Rate limited per taxpayer: a budget of submissions per minute (Efis:RateLimits:DocumentWritesPerMinute, 600 unless the deployment says otherwise), per caller of a taxpayer; a batch costs one per document and is refused whole when it does not fit. Every answer carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; a refusal is 429 rate_limited with Retry-After, and spends no number.

post.description: Runs every check POST /v1/documents runs before a document is numbered (DEV-1720, DEV-2361) and answers with what it found: issuable, the problems that would refuse it, the document as efis would store it (totals after the rounding rule and the VAT summary per rate) and the warnings it would carry. Nothing is numbered, signed or stored, and no Idempotency-Key is taken. 200 whether or not the document is issuable.

get.description: Every document the list shows for the same q and queue, as CSV or Excel (DEV-2198): format=csv or xlsx (required), queue=attention for the error queue, state for one state (all, or absent, for every state), language=sq (default) or en for the headers. All rows, not one page. ids (comma-separated document ids, at most 1000) exports only those rows, for a selection (DEV-2363). mustAct=true exports only the documents the taxpayer must act on, as the list does (DEV-2423). Amounts keep two decimals: before VAT, VAT, and the total with fees; timestamps keep their offset.

The printed invoices of several documents as one ZIP (DEV-2363): ids, comma-separated, at most 100. A read, so a GET; each PDF is the one GET /v1/documents/{id}/pdf gives. A document that has none (not an invoice, not in this business) is left out and named in not-included.txt inside the ZIP.
The e-invoice built from one document, if it has one.

The UBL e-invoice built from one document, exactly as stored, for the partner's software to deliver to the buyer (efis sends no email). 404 when the document is not an e-invoice, or its UBL is not built yet; the document.files_ready webhook says when it is.

get.description: The invoice as printed for the customer, in the order and wording Instruction 16/2020 Art. 9 sets. Once the authority has accepted the document and its printout is stored, these are the stored bytes, the same every time, and never a fresh render; before then it is rendered on request.

post.description: The business's own invoice PDF (base64 in pdf) for step 50 to stamp and keep: the verification QR of Instruction 16/2020 Art. 12 and the codes of Art. 9, appended as an incremental update. It is checked against the stamp before it is kept, so a PDF that cannot be stamped is refused with 422 and a named reason. A later upload replaces an earlier one until step 50 runs; after that the stored invoice is final (409). The ceiling is 2 MB.

The caller's own invoice PDF (base64 in pdf) with the verification QR of Instruction 16/2020 Art. 12 and the elements of Art. 9 the caller's template cannot know -- the invoice number, the authority's registration code and the issuer's security code -- stamped on its first page. The stamp is an incremental update: the answer begins with the uploaded bytes, unchanged. An encrypted PDF, one whose last cross-reference section is a cross-reference stream, and a document with no verification URL are refused with 422 and a named reason; the ceiling on the upload is 2 MB.

Declares why a document the worker parked for a missing reason code is late, and sends it again. Only a person may declare it (X-Session; a machine credential is refused): the code is the taxpayer's statement to the authority and must match the real cause. Who chose it and why are kept on the document's record. A document that is not parked for a missing reason (409 not_parked_for_missing_reason) or already has a declared cause (409 reason_already_declared) is refused.

get.description: The document's pipeline steps (BUILD_SPEC 7.2), by step number: state, when each became applicable, attempts out of the retry budget, the backoff a failed step waits for, and the fault that parked one.

post.description: Asks for a pipeline step to run against an existing document: it clears the step's backoff so the next drain pass takes it. Only step 40, the submission, has a runner today. A completed step never re-runs (409), a parked step waits for a person (409), and a step whose retry budget is spent is not granted more by asking (409).

get.description: Every period of the business's agent-owned tills, open and closed, with the device-failure clock where a device stopped.

post.description: Gives a till's cash sequence to the business's edge agent: from then on only the agent numbers that till's cash receipts, and eFis cloud refuses to (422 device_owned_by_edge_agent). With the till's standby device code (422 standby_required), confirmed in the registry and not another till's (422 standby_unavailable), so a declared loss moves the till at once. Only for a business on per_device_cash_and_unit_non_cash (409 numbering_model_not_per_device), a device the registry confirmed (422 device_not_confirmed), a live connected system the business paired (422 edge_agent_unknown), a till eFis cloud has never numbered a cash receipt for (409 device_has_cash_receipts), with no owner (409 device_already_owned), and not retired (409 device_retired). Only a person may attach one (X-Session).

Declares that a handed-back till's edge agent data is lost. The device code's sequence ends at the highest number eFis holds, and the code is never numbered again (422 device_retired). The till moves to its standby code, under eFis cloud or a new agent. Receipts above that number may exist on the failed device: they are reported, not reissued. eFis sends nothing to the authority. Only the business's Owner (403 owner_required).

Takes a till back from its edge agent: the handback starts, and no one issues the till's receipts until it closes. With the reason, and when the device stopped if it did, which starts the device-failure clock (Law 87/2019 Art. 30(3), (4)). Only the business's Owner or Accountant (403 owner_or_accountant_required).
Names the standby device code of an agent's till that has none, once. Only a person may (X-Session).

get.description: E-invoices the authority lists for this business as buyer, as last synchronised, newest first. ?waiting=true lists only those still waiting for an answer, soonest book review (answerBy) first.

post.description: Queues one accept or refuse for several received e-invoices (DEV-2363), at most 100. Each is checked and queued exactly as POST /v1/einvoices/inbound/{id}/decision would, and the answer says per row whether it was queued or why not. The worker sends each once; none can be withdrawn. The authority's change of status carries no reason, so none is taken.

get.description: Every received e-invoice the list shows, as CSV or Excel (DEV-2198): format=csv or xlsx (required), waiting=true for only those still waiting for an answer, language=sq (default) or en for the headers. All rows, not one page. Amounts keep two decimals; timestamps keep their offset.

post.description: Queues the buyer's accept or refuse. The worker sends it once; it cannot be withdrawn.

get.description: The business's e-invoices to buyers, newest first.
The UBL document exactly as it was built and stored.

post.description: Records a payment the bank will not report, to be filed by the 10th of the following month.

get.description: Inbound e-invoices received in a period, as CSV, for the purchase book.
The business's e-invoices a buyer refused, newest refusal first, each with the book review its corrective is due before and whether one has been issued. ?open=true leaves out the corrected ones.

post.description: Records the authority's confirmation that a premise has no coverage, for the dates it states: one year at most (UdhÃ«zim 16 Art. 34(5)). A NOINTERNET document of that premise issued inside the dates is due by the end of the 10th of the month after its issue (Art. 34(11)). A person records it: signed in (X-Session), or named by a partner key with X-Acting-User-Id and X-Acting-Via. A partner key without them is refused (400 acting_person_required), as is a paired business credential (403 person_required).

A person records it: signed in (X-Session), or named by a partner key with X-Acting-User-Id and X-Acting-Via. A partner key without them is refused (400 acting_person_required), as is a paired business credential (403 person_required). A working assumption pending the authority's confirmation (DEV-2036).
